english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.8 and 3.3 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

date and location

english.notes: This Byelaw applies on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
